def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    T = list(map(int, data[2:2+q]))
    
    teeth = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    for t in T:
        teeth[t] = 1 - teeth[t]
    
    print(teeth.count(1))
